title: Reunion of Siblings
next_chapter_hook: Chen Nian took out an ancient jade pendant from her embrace, on whose surface faintly emerged the pattern clue of the second Tianji Record Fragment—Chen Ji realized that what his father had left at his deathbed might be far more than a simple heirloom.

text.content: The morning mist at Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters had yet to dissipate. Chen Ji crouched by the medicinal field, mechanically pulling weeds while his mind had long wandered elsewhere. Master Mo's parting words, 'The fate of Chapter Seven Hundred is not an ending, but a beginning,' like a thorn deeply embedded in his Mental Sea, impossible to extract. He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment warming slightly, and that hazy vision of the future lingered before him—three days from now, the Sect Competition, someone would die.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji? Is Chen Ji here?

text.content: That voice... Chen Ji jumped to his feet, scattering the weeds in his hands. He thought he was mistaken, or perhaps this was one of the Tianji Record's prophetic visions. But the timbre was achingly familiar—familiar in the way he had countless times longed for in dreams and feared in nightmares over the past decade. It was his sister's voice, it was Chen Nian. The dilapidated wooden door of the Servants' Quarters swung open, a slender figure silhouetted against the light, morning sun outlining her gaunt frame, still bearing traces of her childhood form.

Chen Ji stood frozen, his lips trembling slightly. Ten years—since the Holy Sect took her away, he had believed they would never meet again in this lifetime. The Tianji Record had never shown him a clear vision of her—that hazy, mist-like aura had always reminded him that Chen Nian's existence itself interfered with Heavenly Secrets power. He had speculated countless times whether she was still alive, and now she stood before him, painfully real.

dialogue.content: How... how did you get in? Didn't the mountain guard disciples stop you? What about the people from the Holy Sect? Were you followed?

text.content: A string of questions burst from Chen Ji's lips, the sharpness in his tone even catching himself off guard. He stepped forward, gripping Chen Nian's shoulders, his gaze swiftly scanning beyond the door—no suspicious aura, no abnormal fluctuations in the formation arrays, everything seemed impossibly smooth. As someone accustomed to scheming from the shadows, this 'just right' level of ease made his spine crawl with unease. He made a mental note: while this reunion stirred his heart profoundly, dangers lurking in the darkness might be closing in.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's appearance was too sudden. With Chen Ji's years of strategic experience, he had to confirm whether danger followed. But before him stood his sister who had been missing for ten years, reason and emotion fiercely at war.

choices.description: Ten years of separation—he was already weary of calculation. Since his sister could find her way here alone, it proved she had the ability to protect herself. For now, enjoy this rare moment of reunion.
choices.visible_reward: Sibling affection deepens, gaining family intelligence
choices.risk_hint: If she were being controlled or followed, the consequences would be unthinkable

dialogue.content: Brother... why have you gotten so thin?

text.content: Chen Ji's defenses completely collapsed. He pulled Chen Nian into his embrace, his voice hoarse and barely recognizable: 'Ten years... I searched for you for ten years.' He closed his eyes, letting those carefully woven schemes temporarily recede—in this embrace, he was no master strategist manipulating the world, just an elder brother who had finally found his sister.

choices.text: Observing secretly, clarifying her intentions first
choices.description: The more touching the moment, the more one must stay calm. He had witnessed the Holy Sect's methods—the Demonic Path Soul Control Technique could make people become pawns without their knowledge. First probe how much she knows.
choices.visible_reward: Discovering hidden dangers early, gaining the initiative
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Nian truly returned, this would cause her secondary harm

dialogue.content: Brother? Brother, what's wrong? It's me, Nian'er, don't you... don't you recognize me?

text.content: Chen Ji released his grip, stepping back half a pace, his gaze scanning Chen Nian's face. Her features still faintly carried her childhood contours, but ten years was enough to change so much. He noticed the barely visible black markings at her wrist—the Holy Sect's imprint, something no disguise could forge. 'Nian'er, how did you escape? What about those people from the Holy Sect?' His tone was gentle, yet a subtle coldness flickered in the depths of his eyes—if this were a trap, he needed to know who was pulling the strings behind the scenes.

Chen Nian seemed to sense her brother's complex emotions. She showed no anger; instead, she offered a knowing smile—that smile, matching his memories perfectly, instantly brought her to life. 'Brother, you're still the same. I left markers along the way, didn't you notice?' She raised her hand, condensing a wisp of pale golden spiritual energy that traced an ancient, simple talisman in the air. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—that was the unique bloodline seal of the Chen family, impossible for outsiders to know.

dialogue.content: Father taught me this before he died. He said if I ever found you someday, I should use this to prove my identity. Brother, when he was alive, he talked about you every day...

text.content: Chen Ji's heart clenched painfully. When their father passed away, he had been in seclusion attempting to break through a cultivation realm, missing the final goodbye—this became his deepest regret. Watching the tears glistening in his sister's eyes, all his scheming and wariness crumbled at this moment. He stepped forward, taking her hands again: 'Nian'er, I'm sorry... It's this brother's failure. I couldn't protect you both.' His voice was low, every word seeming to be squeezed from his chest.

dialogue.content: It's not Brother's fault, it's those demon monsters from the Holy Sect! Brother, Father passed peacefully. He asked me to give you this...

choice.prompt: Chen Nian said she had brought their father's heirloom, and Chen Ji needed to decide how to face this possible family inheritance.

choices.text: First inquire about the Holy Sect's situation, prioritize intelligence
choices.description: Father has passed; dwelling on details serves no purpose. The priority is understanding why the Holy Sect released her and whether there's a conspiracy. The premise of protecting his sister is first gaining knowledge of the enemy's movements.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily set aside the father's heirloom
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence on the Holy Sect's movements
choices.risk_hint: May make his sister feel he doesn't value their father's entrustment

dialogue.content: Nian'er, why would the Holy Sect let you leave? How did you escape? Did they send anyone to follow you?

text.content: Chen Nian froze for a moment, then her eyes reddened, but she quickly steadied her emotions and nodded firmly: 'Brother, I understand. Something major happened at the Holy Sect recently—internal chaos. They couldn't be bothered to watch over us "special materials"...' She paused, 'But I know they'll realize soon enough. I have to tell you what Father asked before that happens.'

choices.text: First look at what Father left behind
choices.description: Father's deathbed entrustment surely holds deep meaning. Since Nian'er made it here, she has shown sufficient caution and wisdom. For now, fulfill Father's dying wish.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot immediately assess the current level of danger
choices.visible_reward: Obtain father's heirloom and crucial clues
choices.risk_hint: If the heirloom involves major secrets, it may attract those with ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing his urgent desire. Whatever conspiracy lay ahead, the most important thing now was their father's deathbed entrustment. He said softly, 'Nian'er, show me what Father left for me.' Chen Nian nodded, trembling as she took a small box wrapped in coarse cloth from her embrace. The box looked very old, its corners worn, but it had been carefully preserved.

dialogue.content: Father said this thing is very important—important enough to need our Chen family's hereditary 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' to guard it... Brother, do you know what a Heavenly Fate Lock Key is?

text.content: Heavenly Fate Lock Key—these four words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He recalled that vague passage from the Tianji Record Fragment: 'The Heavenly Fate Lock Key can seal the changes of Heavenly Secrets, can解除 the calamities of fate.' Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect as the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, while he was chosen by the Tianji Record as its inheritor—what secret was hidden in this box their father left behind?

dialogue.content: Brother, Father said... he said the Tianji Record doesn't consist of just one page. The clue to the second page is hidden in this box. But he asked me to warn you—don't go looking for it until you're strong enough...

text.content: Chen Ji took the box, his fingertips tracing the coarse cloth surface. He could feel faint spiritual energy fluctuations emanating from within, familiar yet foreign, as if calling to the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea. Before Master Mo vanished, he said 'the fate of Chapter Seven Hundred is not an ending'—if the Tianji Record truly had a second page, was the clue their father left behind the key to opening that door? He slowly unwrapped the coarse cloth, revealing the box lid's simple Chen family seal. Just then—

choice.prompt: The box is about to be opened, but Chen Ji acutely senses something amiss—this unusual feeling forces him to make a final decision.

choices.description: This is Father's heirloom left for him; Nian'er witnessing it is only proper. Moreover, he needs to know what's inside to judge his next course of action.
choices.visible_cost: May expose crucial clues to potential enemies
choices.risk_hint: If someone is watching, may expose the Tianji Record's secret

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He took a deep breath and gently lifted the box lid. Inside lay a warm jade pendant, on which was carved an ancient talisman, and at its center faintly emerged a miniature map—no, that wasn't an ordinary map, but the outline of the second Tianji Record Fragment! Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply as he felt the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea violently shuddering, as if in jubilation, or in lamentation.

choices.text: First set up a perception barrier before opening
choices.description: Father specifically warned 'don't seek it until you're strong enough,' indicating the second page involves tremendous danger. Before opening anything that might expose secrets, first ensure you're not being spied upon.
choices.risk_hint: The barrier may be detected by高手

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, spiritual energy condensing into a subtle talisman at his fingertip—a small technique he had incidentally learned from some ruins, capable of temporarily isolating all detection within five hundred zhang. 'Nian'er, watch the door for me.' Though puzzled, Chen Nian nodded and walked to the door. Chen Ji took another deep breath, slowly lifting the box lid. The jade pendant inside glowed with a soft radiance, and in that moment, he felt a long-dormant force awakening within his Mental Sea—the clue to the second Tianji Record Fragment lay within this seemingly ordinary jade pendant.

Just then, Chen Nian's face suddenly changed drastically: 'Brother, someone's coming! At least three, all Foundation Building Late Stage!' Chen Ji's eyes turned cold and sharp, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea shook frantically—the vague future vision was becoming clear: at the Sect Competition three days later, someone would die, and that person's face... He tightly gripped the jade pendant, saying coldly, 'Nian'er, stay close to me. Not a single word of today's events can reach a fourth person.'

dialogue.content: Brother, I'm not afraid. Ten years, I've waited for this day for so long. No matter whether there are blade mountains or seas of fire ahead, Nian'er will be by your side.

text.content: Chen Ji looked at his sister, seeing in her eyes a light identical to his own. The little girl who had been taken away ten years ago, only able to cry, had now grown into a warrior capable of standing shoulder to shoulder with him. He tucked the jade pendant into his embrace, turned, and pulled Chen Nian into the depths of the medicinal field. Master Mo's words still echoed in his ears, the Tianji Record's secrets had only just begun to reveal their tip of the iceberg, and his chess game was stepping into an entirely new phase.
